CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.
   B. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
   C. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
   B. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Physical has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   D. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing values? (1 mark)
   A. Use Sharing values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing values.
   D. Say Sharing values has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

9. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.
   D. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

12. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   C. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Obedience values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Church as a By the end of the Sub strand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain My 1.0 Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

3. C — Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. A — Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
